blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Former lawmaker Robert Ace Barbers on Wednesday called on the government to conduct a comprehensive investigation into the reported cyberattacks targeting government agencies and private institutions, warning that it has become a national security concern. Barbers made the pronouncement amid reports that 20 Philippine institutions have been allegedly compromised recently by hackers.
